appDescription: RestSync helps drivers find a rest stop on the active Pleos navigation route, plan breaks before a fixed arrival deadline, and get a timely departure reminder.

function.name: FIND_REST_STOP
function.description: Open RestSync and search for suitable rest stops on the current route when a driver says they are tired, hungry, or want a break.

arrivalTime.description: Desired arrival deadline in local HH:mm format

function.name: SELECT_REST_STOP
function.description: Help the driver confirm a rest stop from a route search. Real waypoint insertion requires verified navigation results and user confirmation.

stopNumber.description: One-based index of the desired rest stop

function.name: START_REST
function.description: Ask RestSync to begin the parked rest session, requiring manual safety and parking confirmation.

restMinutes.description: Requested break duration in minutes, 1 to 180.

function.name: CHECK_REST_TIME
function.description: Read the actual remaining break time and departure deadline.

function.name: EXTEND_REST
function.description: Extend an active break. The arrival deadline always takes priority.

function.name: END_REST
function.description: Ask to finish an active break and show its completion screen.
